verdict.rationale: Replica-skill is a Claude Code skill pack whose stages the user runs manually in order. Scheduled or recurring execution is a fair question for an AI workflow tool, but nothing in the evidence shows the product can schedule jobs. The 'reminder emails' item is a feature added to the generated clone app, not a scheduler for the user's own workflows, so it does not count. Running the skills in sequence is a one-off manual pipeline, not a recurring schedule.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
